title: Indices
audit_comment: INDICES, printed pp. 127-128, the closing pair: the subject index of the whole book on p. 127 - 132 entries from the abjurations and alterations through the Yggdrasil, naming the planes (Astral 5, 60-72; Ethereal 5-21; inner 5, 22-59; outer 5, 73-116; the Prime 5, 117-119; the para-elemental and quasi-elemental 22-59), the rivers (Oceanus 84, 90; the Styx 83, 100-101, 103, 105; Mnemosyne 101 restored from the OCR Manale), the landmarks (Mount Olympus 72, 92, 105; Yggdrasil 72, 95, 105), the creatures (Bahamut and the archons 88, Charon and the charonadaemons 83, the dao and djian and efreet and marids, the githyanki and githzerai with their silver swords 61, 72, 99, the modrons 85, Nidhogg 106, the norns 116, Cerberus 106 restored from the OCR Corberus, the trillochs, the xag-ya and xeg-yi 54, the einheriar 122, the outer-planes creatures 122-123 and the inner 120-121), the mechanics (color pools 80, 82-84; conduits 66, 74; the ether cyclone 17; the psychic wind 64, 67; the silver cord 60-61; wormholes 66; subjective time and true time 5-6; the power compass 75; the borders intercalm, interlayer and interplanar 76); and the spell index of p. 128 - 89 spells with its stated purpose, the pages of unusual or important notes and the exceptions to the spell-type rules: the five airy variants (earth, element, fire, smoke, water), astral projection across its seven pages, plane shift at 11, 22, 61, 74, 117, teleport without error 75, the wish 79 and alter reality 79 and limited wish 79, the negative and positive plane protections 54, the two transform-element spells 28, contact other plane 35, 45, 49, 80, the chariot of Sustarre 29 restored to the real name, stone tell 28 restored from the OCR stone tail, and the necromancies restored from the OCR neoromantics.
